stage_a_dry_run.name: Stage A: Synthetic Dry Run & Pipeline Stress Test
validation_criteria: Schema v2.0 correctly rejects invalid coordinates and future timestamps
Review queue successfully logs cryptographically chained supervisor actions
Field session CLI handles initialize, start, abort, and close cycles

stage_b_non_hazardous_vantage.name: Stage B: Authorized Dry-Weather Baseline Observation
validation_criteria: Team successfully occupies elevated footbridge without vehicular interaction
Calibrated non-contact optical rangefinder and staff gauges tested from railing
Zero identifiable bystander faces or private properties captured in telephoto imagery
Observations ingested into encrypted raw vault with 100% metadata completeness

stage_c_weather_event_observation.name: Stage C: Controlled Monsoon Weather-Event Observation
stage_c_weather_event_observation.prerequisites_required: PilotActivationGate evaluates to PILOT_AUTHORIZED and Stage B cleared
validation_criteria: Pre-collection safety check strictly enforced by Field Lead prior to dispatch
Safety Officer maintains 360-degree awareness; zero entry into standing water
Abort triggers (lightning < 10km, wind > 35km/h, rising water) strictly enforced
Water depth measurements recorded with explicit provenance (staff vs curb index)

stage_d_data_quality_audit.name: Stage D: Data Quality & Disagreement Audit
stage_d_data_quality_audit.prerequisites_required: Completion of at least 2 Stage C observation shifts
validation_criteria: Zero circular validation leakage from historical hotspot catalog
Separation of verified inundation episodes from modeled environmental risk
